foreground.meaning: default text on background and card

card.meaning: surface fill; components.css mixes it with --surface-alpha

primary-emphasis.meaning: primary as legible text on background, card and accent

accent.meaning: light tint of primary (hover, primary tag)

brand-ink.meaning: brand text at least 4.5:1 (action rows, two-tone titles)

border.meaning: hairline; also the default border colour

tint.meaning: ink at about 6 %, alpha baked in (no /modifier)

tint-strong.meaning: ink at about 10 %, alpha baked in

segment-active.meaning: active pill of segmented tabs and toggles

field-edge.meaning: form field edge at rest (about 2:1), alpha baked in

field-edge-strong.meaning: field edge on hover or open (about 3:1)

--nav-h.meaning: height of the fixed top chrome; sticky offsets and full-height frames

--radius.meaning: base radius; theme radii sm to xl derive from it

--surface-alpha.meaning: opacity of the card fill of .surface

--surface-glass-alpha.meaning: opacity of the card fill of .surface-glass

--layer-raised.meaning: sticky table headers, icons inside fields

--layer-sticky.meaning: sticky form actions and jump bars

--layer-overlay.meaning: sheet and dialog overlay and content

--layer-popover.meaning: popover, select, dropdown menu, tooltip, command list

hostRequirements: dark mode: a .dark class on an ancestor; the dark: variant is defined by the host
default border colour = the border role
animation utilities animate-in/out, fade-*, zoom-*, slide-in-from-* (tw-animate-css or equivalent)
